fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

instructions.name: addAsyncDeploymentTarget
docs: Adds an async deployment target for the given strategy type.
When the pool is not closed.
* `strategy_type` - The async strategy type to add the deployment target for.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} adds ${data.targetKey} as a ${data.strategyType} async deployment target of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addDeploymentTarget
docs: Add a deployment target for the given strategy type.
When the pool is not closed.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type to add the deployment target for.
* `target_key` - The key of the deployment target.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} adds ${data.targetKey} as a ${data.strategyType} deployment target of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addInstantWithdrawalLender
docs: Adds a new instant withdrawal lender to the pool.
When the pool is not closed.
* `lender` - The address of the instant withdrawal lender.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} lets ${data.lender} withdraw instantly from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} without fees

instructions.name: addMode
docs: Adds a mode to the pool.
When the pool is not closed.
* `target_apy_bps` - The target annual percentage yield (APY) for the underlying assets
See the docs for `ModeConfig` on how `target_apy_bps` is related to the actual APY used
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} adds mode ${data.modeName} to pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, with a target APY of ${data.targetApyBps}

instructions.name: addPoolOperator
docs: Adds a new operator to the pool.
When the pool is not closed.
* `operator` - The address of the pool operator.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} adds ${data.operator} as an operator of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addRedemptionRequestV2
docs: Adds a new redemption request. `payer` will pay for the account rent-exempt fees.
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to redeem.
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} asks to redeem ${data.shares} of ${accounts.modeMint} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, to be paid out later: the tokens move from ${accounts.lenderModeToken} to the pool until the request is processed

instructions.name: addStrategyManagerWallet
docs: Adds a new wallet for the strategy manager to the pool.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} adds ${data.wallet} as a strategy manager wallet of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: approveManualStrategyManager
docs: Approves a pending manual strategy manager proposal.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.humaOwner} approves the proposed manual strategy manager of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: cancelManualStrategyManagerProposal
docs: Cancels a pending manual strategy manager proposal.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.intent: Cancel a manual strategy manager proposal
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} cancels the proposed manual strategy manager of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: cancelRedemptionRequest
docs: Reduces the number of shares request for redemption.
* `shares` - The number of shares in the redemption request to be canceled.
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
Only the pool owner and the Sentinel service account can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} cancels ${data.shares} of ${accounts.modeMint} from redemption request ${accounts.redemptionRequest} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, returning them to ${accounts.lenderModeToken}

instructions.name: changePoolOwner
docs: When the pool is not closed.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} makes ${data.newOwner} the owner of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: clearInstantWithdrawalLiquiditySource
docs: Clears the deployment target from which liquidity is pulled when the pool's available
balance is insufficient to satisfy an instant withdrawal.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} clears the deployment target instant withdrawals from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} draw on

instructions.name: closeLenderAccounts
docs: Closes the accounts owned by the lender.
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} closes their lender state in mode ${accounts.modeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: closePool
docs: Closes the pool after its maturity.
Only when the pool is in the pre-closure status.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} closes pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: completeLiquidityPaybackAsync
docs: Completes a previously initiated payback via an async strategy. Claims the
redeemed underlying tokens from the target and updates pool accounting.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} claims the ${accounts.underlyingMint} redeemed from async deployment target ${accounts.asyncDeploymentConfig} (${data.strategyType}) into pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: createLenderAccountsV2
docs: Creates the accounts necessary for a lender. `payer` will pay for the account rent-exempt fees.
1. For the pool owner treasury: when the pool is not closed.
2. For other lenders: when both the protocol and pool are on.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} opens the lender accounts of ${accounts.lender} in mode ${accounts.modeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: createPool
docs: * `pool_owner_treasury` - The address of the pool owner treasury, which will be responsible
for providing initial liquidity and receiving pool owner fees.
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
Anyone can call this instruction. The signer will become the owner of the pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} creates pool ${data.poolName} for ${accounts.underlyingMint}, with treasury ${data.poolOwnerTreasury} and loss authority ${data.lossAuthority}

instructions.name: declareLoss
docs: Declares loss on an investment. When the loss is on liquid assets, the strategy manager must
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
It is possible for the strategy manager to deploy and pay back liquidity after loss declaration.
Only the loss authority can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lossAuthority} declares a loss of ${data.loss} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: deployLiquidity
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool to investment opportunities.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status. Deployment
is allowed in pre-closure in case the strategy manager accidentally pays more liquidity back
than required for withdrawal and needs to take the funds back.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

instructions.name: deployLiquidityAsync
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool via an async strategy.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is on or in pre-closure.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} deploys ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to async deployment target ${accounts.asyncDeploymentConfig} (${data.strategyType})

instructions.name: deployLiquidityManually
docs: Deploys liquidity from the pool via the manual strategy. Only manual strategy managers
can call this instruction. Subject to per-transaction and daily deployment limits.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
Only manual strategy managers can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} deploys ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} through the manual strategy

instructions.name: disablePool
docs: Disables the pool. Once a pool is disabled, no money moves in or out.
Only when the pool is on.
Only pool operators can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOperator} disables pool ${accounts.poolConfig}: no money moves in or out until it is turned on again

instructions.name: disburse
docs: Transfers all the amount that has been redeemed but not yet disbursed to the lender.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} claims all the ${accounts.underlyingMint} owed to them from processed redemptions in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, paid to ${accounts.lenderUnderlyingToken}

instructions.name: enablePool
docs: Turns on the pool. Before a pool is turned on, the required mode liquidity must be
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} turns on pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: enterPreClosure
docs: Puts the pool in pre-closure status so that final processing can happen to prepare
for closure. Pool assets will be refreshed one last time and lenders will no longer accrue
yields after the pool enters the pre-closure status.
N/A. The instruction can be triggered at any time.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} puts pool ${accounts.poolConfig} in pre-closure: lenders stop earning yield

available immediately and must be claimed in a separate step via
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
* `shares` - The number of shares to redeem.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} asks async deployment target ${accounts.asyncDeploymentConfig} (${data.strategyType}) to redeem ${data.shares} shares for pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, to be claimed in a later step

instructions.name: instantWithdraw
docs: Allows a lender to withdraw their own shares directly, bypassing the redemption queue.
This provides immediate liquidity when the pool has sufficient available balance.
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to withdraw.
* `max_fee` - The maximum fee in token base units the lender is willing to
accept. The fee is computed progressively across the liquid-asset-ratio brackets
the withdrawal traverses; if the resulting total exceeds `max_fee`, the instruction
Only when both the protocol and the pool are on.
Any lender can call this instruction for their own shares.

instructions.name: makeInitialDeposit
docs: Allows the pool owner to make initial deposit before the pool goes live.
* `assets` - The amount of underlying assets to be deposited.
* `commitment` - The commitment type of the deposit.
The number of mode token minted.
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
Only authorized initial depositors can call this instruction.
The parameter `commitment` has type `String` instead of `enum` so that we can avoid program
upgrade when we add additional commitment types in the future.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwnerTreasury} makes the pool owner's initial deposit of ${data.assets} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} into mode ${accounts.modeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, for ${accounts.modeMint} paid to ${accounts.poolOwnerTreasuryModeToken}

instructions.name: payBackLiquidity
docs: Pays back liquidity to the pool.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

accounts.name: poolAuthority
docs: deserialize. Mutable only because Jupiter Lending incorrectly requires the signer account
Only when a deployment target is passed: the accounts the target's lending protocol (Jupiter Lend or Kamino Lend) needs to deposit or withdraw the pool's funds, ending with that protocol's programs.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} pays back ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from deployment target ${accounts.deploymentConfig} (${data.strategyType}) to pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: payBackLiquidityManually
docs: Pays back liquidity to the pool via the manual strategy.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is not closed.
Only manual strategy managers can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} pays back ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} to pool ${accounts.poolConfig} through the manual strategy

instructions.name: processRedemptionRequest
docs: Processes the redemption request at the beginning of the redemption queue.
When the protocol is on, and the pool is either on or in the pre-closure status.
Only the pool owner and the Sentinel service account can call this instruction.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The recipient of the `RedemptionRequest` account rent-exempt fee refunds after closure.

accounts.name: strategyManagerWallet
docs: Strategy managers wallets are allowed to process redemption requests. If the signer
is a strategy manager wallet this account needs to be passed in for validation. Otherwise,
the account can be left as `None`.

accounts.name: lenderUnderlyingToken
docs: The account is optional to prevent an attack where a lender closes their underlying token
account and consequently blocks the redemption request from being processed.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} processes redemption request ${accounts.redemptionRequest} of ${accounts.lender}, the first in the queue of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: proposeManualStrategyManager
docs: Proposes a new manual strategy manager for the pool.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction. The proposal must be approved

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} proposes ${data.wallet} as manual strategy manager of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, pending the Huma owner's approval

instructions.name: recoverLoss
docs: Recovers declared losses by transferring assets from the loss authority to the pool.
The transferred amount is applied to mode losses proportionally. When the recovery applies to
losses on liquid assets, the strategy manager must also update `liquid_assets_deployed` accordingly.
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
* `amount` - The amount to transfer from the loss authority to the pool for loss recovery.
Only the loss authority can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lossAuthority} pays ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from ${accounts.lossAuthorityUnderlyingToken} into pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to recover declared losses

instructions.name: refreshModeAssets
docs: Refreshes the assets in a single mode to bring it up to date.
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed. When the pool is in pre-closure,

display.interpolatedIntent: Brings the assets of mode ${accounts.modeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig} up to date

instructions.name: refreshPoolAssets
docs: Refreshes the assets in all modes to bring them up to date.
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed. When the pool is in pre-closure,
The pool's mode configs (classic and maxi), in the order the pool state lists them; each is refreshed.

display.interpolatedIntent: Brings the assets of every mode of pool ${accounts.poolConfig} up to date

instructions.name: removeAsyncDeploymentTarget
docs: When the pool is not closed.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} removes async deployment target ${accounts.asyncDeploymentConfig} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removeDeploymentTarget
docs: Removes a deployment target for the given strategy type.
When the pool is not closed.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} removes deployment target ${accounts.deploymentConfig} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removeInstantWithdrawalLender
docs: Removes an instant withdrawal lender from the pool.
When the pool is not closed.
* `lender` - The address of the instant withdrawal lender.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} removes ${data.lender} as an instant withdrawal lender of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removeManualStrategyManager
docs: Removes a manual strategy manager from the pool.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} removes the manual strategy manager of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removeMode
docs: Removes a mode from the pool. Please note that this instruction applies solely to the
reversal of unintentional mode additions. Consequently, the following conditions must
be met for the removal to go through:
1. No mode token has been minted.
2. The mode state must be empty.
When the pool is not closed.
* `mode_id` - The ID of the mode to remove.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} removes mode ${accounts.modeConfig} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removePoolOperator
docs: Adds an operator from the pool.
When the pool is not closed.
* `operator` - The address of the pool operator.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} removes ${data.operator} as an operator of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: removeStrategyManagerWallet
docs: Removes a wallet for the strategy manager from the pool.
Only when the protocol and pool are both on.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} removes strategy manager record ${accounts.strategyManagerWallet} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: setHumaConfig
docs: Points the pool at a different `HumaConfig` account. Used only in the rare event
that the Huma protocol is redeployed with a new `HumaConfig`.
When the pool is not closed.
Only the current Huma owner can call this instruction. Pool owner cannot, since
swapping the `HumaConfig` changes which Huma owner governs the pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} points pool ${accounts.poolConfig} at Huma config ${accounts.newHumaConfig}

instructions.name: setInstantWithdrawalFeeConfigs
docs: Sets the instant withdrawal fee configurations.
When the pool is not closed.
* `fee_configs` - The fee configurations. Each config specifies a liquid asset ratio
threshold and fee in basis points. There can be at most `MAX_INSTANT_WITHDRAWAL_FEE_CONFIGS`
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets the instant withdrawal fee tiers of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: setInstantWithdrawalLiquiditySource
docs: Sets the deployment target from which liquidity will be pulled when the pool's available
balance is insufficient to satisfy an instant withdrawal.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} makes deployment target ${accounts.deploymentConfig} the source instant withdrawals from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} draw on when the pool's own balance is short

instructions.name: setInstantWithdrawalReserveLimit
docs: Sets the instant withdrawal reserve limit.
When the pool is not closed.
* `new_reserve_limit` - The new instant withdrawal reserve limit.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets the instant withdrawal reserve limit of pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to ${data.newReserveLimit}

instructions.name: setLiquidAssetsDeployed
docs: Sets the amount of liquid assets, used for instant withdrawal fee tier selection.
When the protocol is on and the pool is not closed.
* `liquid_assets_deployed` - The liquid assets deployed amount in underlying token units.
Only strategy manager wallets can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.wallet} records ${data.liquidAssetsDeployed} as the liquid assets pool ${accounts.poolConfig} has deployed

instructions.name: setLossAuthority
docs: When the pool is not closed.
* `new_loss_authority` - The address of the new loss authority.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} makes ${data.newLossAuthority} the loss authority of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: setLpConfig
docs: When the pool is not closed.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets the lender settings of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: setManualDeploymentLimits
docs: Sets the limits for manual deployment of liquidity.
When the pool is not closed.
* `daily_limit` - The maximum cumulative amount that can be deployed manually in a day.
* `per_wallet_limit` - The maximum net amount (deployed minus paid back) that can be outstanding for a single wallet.
Only the pool owner or the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} limits manual deployments from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to ${data.dailyLimit} a day and ${data.perWalletLimit} outstanding per wallet

instructions.name: setPoolOwnerTreasury
docs: When the pool is not closed.
* `new_treasury` - The address of the new pool owner treasury.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} makes ${data.newTreasury} the pool owner treasury of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: setupDeploymentTarget
docs: Performs one-time per-target setup for a deployment target, e.g. initializing required
accounts in the external protocol. Strategies without setup needs treat this as a no-op.
When the pool is not closed.
* `strategy_type` - The strategy type of the target being set up.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets up ${data.strategyType} deployment target ${accounts.deploymentConfig} for pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: switchMode
docs: Switches a lender's investment from one mode to another.
Only when both the protocol and pool are on.
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to switch.
`investment_id` is not used by the program. It's a pass-through argument used by other
systems in the Huma protocol to detect deposit commitment violations.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} switches ${data.shares} of ${accounts.sourceModeMint} from mode ${accounts.sourceModeConfig} to mode ${accounts.destinationModeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, for ${accounts.destinationModeMint} paid to ${accounts.destinationModeToken}

instructions.name: updateModeApy
docs: Updates mode APY. Both the target and periodic APYs will be updated.
When the pool is not closed.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets the target APY of mode ${accounts.modeConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to ${data.newTargetApyBps}

instructions.name: updateModeName
docs: When the pool is not closed.
* `new_name` - The new name of the mode.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} renames mode ${accounts.modeConfig} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to ${data.newName}

instructions.name: updateModeTokenMetadata
docs: When the pool is not closed.
* `args` - The parameters in the token metadata.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} sets the token name, symbol and metadata URI of mode ${accounts.modeConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: updatePoolName
docs: When the pool is not closed.
* `new_name` - The new name of the pool.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} renames pool ${accounts.poolConfig} to ${data.newName}

instructions.name: withdrawAfterPoolClosure
docs: Withdraws all the lender's assets after the pool has been permanently closed.
Only when the protocol is on and the pool is closed.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} redeems all their ${accounts.modeMint} in closed pool ${accounts.poolConfig} for ${accounts.underlyingMint} paid to ${accounts.lenderUnderlyingToken}

docs: Exits an async deployment whose target has been closed. Used as the terminal exit

definedTypes.name: lpconfig
docs: * `liquidity_cap` - The max liquidity allowed for the pool.
* `min_deposit_amount` - The minimum amount a lender needs to supply each time they deposit.
* `min_redemption_shares` - The minimum number of shares a lender has to request for redemption,
unless their total number of shares is lower than this value.
* `max_total_redemption_shares_per_window` - The maximum number of shares that can be requested

definedTypes.name: lenderRedemptionRecord
docs: The information related to a lender's redemption.
* `num_pending_redemption_requests` - The number of pending redemption requests. Note that this
value is only decremented when the redemption request account is closed in `process_redemption_request`,
* `total_amount_processed` - The total amount processed for redemption.
* `total_amount_withdrawn` - The total amount withdrawn by the lender. The withdrawable amount
= `total_amount_processed` - `total_amount_withdrawn`. Since we'll first try to transfer the
processed funds directly to the lender, the withdrawable amount is usually 0. It's only
non-zero if the transfer fails and the funds are kept in the disbursement reserve for the
* `shares_pending_redemption` - The number of shares pending redemption.

definedTypes.name: manageModeTokenMetadataArgs
docs: Parameters used for creating and updating mode token metadata. All string lengths
are checked by the MPL token metadata program, hence omitted here.
* `name` - The name of the mode token.
* `symbol` - The symbol of the mode token.
* `uri` - The URI of additional mode token metadata stored off-chain.

definedTypes.name: modeState
docs: * `assets` - The total amount of underlying assets in th mode. This includes both principals
* `losses` - The total outstanding losses in the mode.
* `cumulative_yields` - The cumulative amount of yields accrued in this mode.
* `assets_refreshed_at` - The last timestamp at which `assets` was refreshed.

definedTypes.name: poolStatus
docs: * `Off` - The pool is temporarily turned off.
* `PreClosure` - The pool is undergoing final processing to prepare for closure.
* `Closed` - The pool is closed after maturity.

definedTypes.name: redemption
docs: States for the global redemption queue.
* `next_request_id` - The ID of the next redemption request to be processed.
* `last_request_id` - The ID of the last unprocessed redemption request in the queue.

definedTypes.name: redemptionGating
docs: * `total_shares_requested` - The total number of shares requested for redemption during
the current window. No redemption request can be submitted once the total shares requested
* `window_starts_at` - The Unix timestamp (UTC) marking the start of the current 24-hour
